getting_here: The B49 bus runs along Bedford Avenue, and Franklin Av and Nostrand Av stations are a short walk.
Street parking on Bedford and the nearby blocks fills up on Sunday, so give yourself a few extra minutes.

first_sunday.title: arrive by 11:45.
first_sunday.text: Greeters meet you at the door and help you find a seat.

first_sunday.title: wear what’s comfortable.
first_sunday.text: You’ll see suits and church hats next to jeans and sneakers.

first_sunday.title: bring the kids.
first_sunday.text: Children are welcome in every service.

first_sunday.title: stay a while.
first_sunday.text: Praise, prayer and the preached Word. Brooklyn worship is never in a hurry.
